items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 46:1
items.html: (To the question) For all the Mochin of face to face come to her in the aspect of an offshoot of the Mochin of ZA, namely by the inclusion of the Malchut of Ima in his crown of Gevura. Therefore, although she ascends with him up to the Keter of Aba and Ima, nevertheless, since all this ascent comes to her by means of ZA, she is smaller than him, and his Keter is discerned as greater than her Keter.
